audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text claims Vel'Koz's R 'can't be cancelled mid-channel'. The kit's own flag says the opposite: 'channel: interruptible — any CC cancels it'.
audit.why: This is a load-bearing tactical error — a player reading this would stand still channeling into a stun expecting it to finish. The R is 2.5s of exposed channel time that any hard CC (including Neeko's E root or R stun) cancels outright.
audit.corrected: Rewrote the sentence to say any CC cancels the channel and to cast it only when Neeko can't reach with CC.
sources: ownerKit R flags: channel — interruptible — any CC cancels it

edits.before: Q-fork the pair, W the pulse, third-hit the research — true math their page can't answer.
edits.after: Neeko's keystone rides a landed Q or E proc — stand at your own max range so her poke never triggers it and she has to walk up to reset the timer.

edits.before: Beaming into a loaded engage — the channel is a verdict for fights already decided.
edits.after: Standing shoulder-to-shoulder with your carry lets one Tangle-Barbs pass root your whole duo for her jump-in — hold separate lines in fights.

edits.before: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs (Root): matchup-defining — The root sets up her whole burst — sidestep it behind minions. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Tectonic Disruption banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Tangle-Barbs (E) is down 12s at rank 1, 10s by rank 5 — it sets up her whole burst, so track the miss and step up before it resets. - Keep your own E banked for her best play. - Pop Blossom (R) is 120/105/90s; a fight decision, not a habit.

edits.before: Your ult out-ranges everything Neeko has and can't be cancelled mid-channel; her Pop Blossom ult has an obvious jump-and-airborne tell (or a slow ground windup), so E her out of it or interrupt the channel and beam her down. Watch for her passive disguise on a minion before a flank.
edits.after: Your ult out-ranges everything Neeko has, but any CC cancels your channel, so only start it when she can't reach you; her Pop Blossom has an obvious jump-and-airborne tell (or a slow ground windup) — E her out of it or beam her down after landing. Watch for her passive disguise on a minion before a flank.

notes: Fixed a real mechanical error: R (Life Form Disintegration Ray) is an interruptible channel, not an uncancellable one — spikes[1].text had it backwards. Left the level chart alone since packet/mirror/content already agree (all Vel'Koz/Skill, matches 55.15% win rate).
